title: Authentication cookie headers
responsibility: Read opaque authentication cookies and construct secure cookie headers.

inputs.name: authCookies.request
inputs.description: The Request whose Cookie header is read. Only that header is inspected; a missing header is treated as empty.

inputs.name: authCookies.name
inputs.description: Selects the cookie key to match in each semicolon-delimited header part after trimming. Matching uses the case-sensitive name= prefix.

inputs.name: issueCookie.name
inputs.description: The cookie name interpolated verbatim before = in the Set-Cookie string. The function does not validate or escape it.

inputs.name: issueCookie.value
inputs.description: The cookie value interpolated verbatim after =. The function does not validate or escape it.

inputs.name: issueCookie.options
inputs.description: Supplies a numeric maxAge and sameSite of Lax or Strict for the header. The object is not validated before its fields are interpolated.

inputs.name: clearCookie.name
inputs.description: The cookie name interpolated verbatim before = in the expired Set-Cookie string. The function does not validate or escape it.

inputs.name: clearCookie.sameSite
inputs.description: Selects Lax or Strict for the expired cookie's SameSite attribute. clearCookie sets the value empty and Max-Age=0.

outputs.name: SESSION_COOKIE
outputs.description: Cookie name for session authentication. It is only the name constant; the cookie header is formed separately by issueCookie.

outputs.name: CHALLENGE_COOKIE
outputs.description: Cookie name for the authentication challenge. It is only the name constant; the cookie header is formed separately by issueCookie.

outputs.name: EMAIL_PROOF_COOKIE
outputs.description: Cookie name for email proof. It is only the name constant; the cookie header is formed separately by issueCookie.

outputs.name: authCookies
outputs.description: Returns a single matching value only if it is 32–128 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ or -. Missing, malformed, or duplicate matches return null.

outputs.name: issueCookie
outputs.description: A Set-Cookie string containing the supplied name, value, Max-Age, and SameSite, plus Path=/, HttpOnly, and Secure. It has no Domain attribute.

outputs.name: clearCookie
outputs.description: A Set-Cookie string for the supplied name with an empty value and Max-Age=0, plus Path=/, HttpOnly, Secure, and the supplied SameSite. It has no Domain attribute.
